answer: A fresh key ties up at the wharf with an empty hold: standing comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts it sealed on-ledger, each one re-checked against consensus. That record is as stubborn to forge as prying a walnut open with bare fingers, and a light sparrow of a clone carries none of it onto a sibling key. A thousand fakes each repay the same seasons of honest judgment, so the sybil bill stays linear in identities and is never shared.
